svg.title: Conduit build profiles
svg.desc: Four layers, each including everything below it. Always on: routing, TLS, filters, basic auth, metrics and the Admin API. Default adds reverse proxy, static files, compression and browser live reload. Standard adds JWT, consumers, forward auth, caching and ACME. Full adds scripting, WebAssembly, TCP proxy, upload, Redis, disk cache, fault injection, OpenTelemetry and Kubernetes.
svg.text: Pick the layer that matches your config; each one includes the layers below
Rhai scripts · WebAssembly plugins · TCP proxy · file upload · Redis · disk cache
fault injection · OpenTelemetry · Kubernetes CRD · event-loop lag gauge
JWT · consumers · forward auth · response cache · ACME auto-TLS
reverse proxy · static files and SPA fallback · compression · browser live reload
routing · TLS and HTTP/2 · IP filter · CORS · security headers · in-memory rate limiting
Basic and API-key auth · redirects · health checks · Prometheus metrics · Admin API
"conduit features -c conduit.yaml" prints the features a config needs, with a ready-to-paste cargo install line.
